## Use-Cases & User Stories for Doorstop

**As a:** Requirement Manager
**I want:** To manage and share requirements effectively
**So that:** My team can collaborate efficiently and deliver high-quality software.

**Use Case 1: Create and Share Requirements**

* **Goal:** Create and share new requirements with stakeholders.
* **Main Flow:**
    1. Create a new requirement.
    2. Add formatting to the requirement text.
    3. Assign unique identifiers to linkable sections.
    4. Share the requirement with other users.
* **Alternative Flow:**
    1. Import content from another requirements management tool.
    2. Export content to interact with common text/document tools.
* **Exception Flow:**
    1. Attempt to create a requirement with an invalid identifier.
    2. Attempt to share a requirement with a user who does not have access.

**Use Case 2: View Requirements**

* **Goal:** View requirements in different formats.
* **Main Flow:**
    1. View requirements as a document.
    2. View document items interactively.
* **Alternative Flow:**
    1. View the baseline version of a requirement.
* **Exception Flow:**
    1. Attempt to view a requirement that does not exist.

**Use Case 3: Manage Requirements**

* **Goal:** Manage versions of requirements.
* **Main Flow:**
    1. Baseline versions of requirements.
* **Alternative Flow:**
    (none)
* **Exception Flow:**
    1. Attempt to baseline a requirement that has already been baseline.

## Use-Cases & User Stories

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to link to specific sections of text within requirements documents.
**So that** I can easily navigate between different sections of the document.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to format the text within linkable sections.
**So that** I can highlight important information and make the document more visually appealing.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to store external requirements assets.
**So that** I can reference external documents and resources within my requirements document.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to import content from other requirements management tools.
**So that** I can consolidate my requirements into a single document.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools.
**So that** I can share my requirements document with other stakeholders.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to view requirements as a document.
**So that** I can easily review and understand the requirements.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to view document items interactively.
**So that** I can navigate between different sections of the document and interact with the content.

**As a** Requirements Engineer
**I want** to be able to baseline versions of requirements.
**So that** I can track changes to the requirements over time.

## Use-Cases & User Stories

**User Stories:**

**As a** Requirement Creator,
**I want** to be able to create new requirements with unique and permanent identifiers,
**So that** I can easily reference and track requirements.

**As a** Requirement Creator,
**I want** to be able to format text within linkable sections,
**So that** I can create visually appealing and informative requirements.

**As a** Requirement Creator,
**I want** to be able to store external requirements assets,
**So that** I can easily reference and share external resources.

**As a** Requirement Importer,
**I want** to be able to import content from other requirements management tools,
**So that** I can consolidate my requirements into one platform.

**As a** Requirement Exporter,
**I want** to be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools,
**So that** I can share my requirements with other teams.

**As a** Requirement Viewer,
**I want** to be able to view requirements as a document,
**So that** I can easily understand the overall structure of the requirements.

**As a** Requirement Viewer,
**I want** to be able to view document items interactively,
**So that** I can explore specific requirements in detail.

**As a** Requirement Versioner,
**I want** to be able to baseline versions of requirements,
**So that** I can track changes and maintain version history.

**User Roles:**

* Requirement Creator
* Requirement Importer
* Requirement Exporter
* Requirement Viewer
* Requirement Versioner
